d: Dr. Prakash Amte and his wife, Dr. Mandakini Amte, are not just a married couple – they are pioneers in wildlife conservation and epitomize a harmonious coexistence with nature. Their family is an unconventional but heartwarming one. In addition to their human family members, they share their lives with an astonishing variety of animal companions, including leopards, bears, crocodiles, and 90 more species, making their home nothing short of a modern-day Noah's Ark.
